prompts.duo:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a production character reference sheet for reusable Christian's Advent artwork, based on the two adult protagonists in the supplied book cover (reference only; do not reproduce the cover).
Mike is the stocky man on the right with receding short brown hair, broad round face, burgundy polo, blue jeans and brown shoes. Christian is the slender man on the left with short sandy brown hair, rectangular glasses, long narrow face, pale sage long-sleeved shirt, blue jeans and brown shoes. Preserve their distinctive illustrated faces, adult ages, proportions, silhouettes, hairlines and glasses. Remove aprons and cooking utensils so these are neutral reusable outfits.
Children's picture-book illustration matching the reference: confident dark ink outlines, expressive but restrained faces, clean flat colors with subtle cel shading. Neither photorealistic nor 3D. Friendly, dignified, no exaggeration beyond the reference.
Transparent background with NO simulated checkerboard. A spacious two-row sheet: upper row has three full-body views of Mike, front, three-quarter, profile; lower row the same three views of Christian. Same size within each row, head to shoes completely visible, relaxed neutral hands, figures completely separated with ample clear margins. No overlaps. No lettering, labels, logos, book title, publisher marks, scenery or props. This is the version-one identity master for later outfit and pose edits, not a finished book cover.
prompts.family:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce a character casting sheet translating EVERY person in reference image 2 (family photo) into the children's book drawing style of reference image 1. Image1 is STYLE ONLY, image2 provides distinct faces/hair/glasses/builds. Preserve individual visual differences; do not swap faces or merge people. No inferred names.
Exactly 12 separated waist-up portrait panels in a tidy 4-column x3-row grid on clean white, thin pale blue dividers, generous margins. Adults/older family members are numbered 01 through 11 in their original LEFT TO RIGHT order in the photograph; baby is 12. Reading order of panels is left-right then next row. Only text: the corresponding two-digit number below each portrait.
01 red-haired woman with high bun, dark rectangular glasses, black shirt.
02 smiling man wearing dark baseball cap, light gray shirt, clean-shaven; draw him alone, baby separately.
03 stocky smiling man with dark cap, short dark beard and mustache, charcoal gray shirt.
04 long straight light brown-haired woman, bright blue shirt.
05 woman with long wavy dark brown hair, dark rectangular glasses, black shirt.
06 young man in dark suit, white shirt, blue tie and broad straw hat. No badges/lettering.
07 middle-aged broad-faced man with receding short light brown hair, red button-up shirt.
08 woman with long brown hair swept over a shoulder, bright blue shirt.
09 woman with dark brown hair, bangs, black shirt and simple necklace.
10 woman with long reddish/light-brown hair, black shirt.
11 woman with long wavy brown hair with lighter streaks, gray shirt.
12 the infant in light onesie, seated supported pose, recognizable round face and light hair, innocent friendly expression.
Confident hand-inked outlines and flat colors with subtle cel shading, natural friendly adult proportions, in the supplied illustrated book's visual language. Do not turn the adults into small children. No brand logos, signs, airport backgrounds, luggage, text other than panel numbers, no religious or occupation labels. This sheet is a reusable likeness draft, not a group photo or finished holiday scene.
prompts.scene:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a sample Advent calendar illustration using the EXACT TWO adult characters from the supplied reference sheet: Mike is the stocky receding-brown-haired man in burgundy at the top; Christian is the slender sandy-haired man with rectangular glasses in sage at the bottom. These are the same two people across every reference view, not six characters. Preserve facial structures, glasses, builds and hairlines. Same inked children's book style, subtle cel shading and crisp readable shapes.
Scene: Mike and Christian sitting at a wooden table together building a small paper gingerbread-house Advent calendar. Mike carefully holds a folded paper roof; Christian positions a little paper door. A few scissors, paper scraps and colored pencils on the table, cozy Christmas tree lights in background. Both look pleasantly absorbed, friendly gentle humor without slapstick. A window shows a quiet snowy evening. Tasteful blue, burgundy and warm amber colors. Landscape composition with both faces clearly visible, appealing as a holiday card, no typography, no publisher mark, no logos, no extra people. Their clothing and faces should match the master exactly. This is a reusable-style demonstration, not a redesign of the characters.
